title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.33158v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has accelerated with the adoption of foundation models, yet evaluating their real-world reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark evaluating retinal fundus models across vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). translated_title: FOCUS：从基础视觉编码器到多模态大语言模型的视网膜模型泛化能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着基础模型的采用，基于AI的视网膜图像分析进展迅速，然而评估其现实世界的可靠性仍然充满挑战。在单一数据集上报告的性能无法反映模型在数据集偏移、不同临床定义或不同患者亚群下的行为表现。这一局限在医学影像领域尤为关键，因为鲁棒性、校准和公平性对于安全部署至关重要。我们提出了FOCUS（Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift，偏移条件下的基础眼科跨数据集理解），这是一个跨数据集基准，用于评估视网膜眼底模型在纯视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）三类架构上的表现。FOCUS在十个公开数据集上统一了二元糖尿病视网膜病变、可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变任务，这些数据集涵盖不同的地理区域、采集条件和……
tldr: 提出FOCUS跨数据集基准，在十个公开数据集上统一糖尿病视网膜病变与青光眼任务，系统评估从纯视觉编码器、视觉-语言模型到多模态大语言模型的视网膜模型在数据偏移下的泛化能力、鲁棒性、校准性与公平性。
en_tdlr: Introduces FOCUS, a cross-dataset benchmark that evaluates retinal fundus models—spanning vision-only encoders, vision-language models, and multimodal LLMs—on generalization, robustness, calibration, and fairness under dataset shift across ten public datasets with harmonized diabetic retinopathy and glaucoma tasks.
